{{Quote|Some local Ragtags keep messing with me and my work. That's partly why I agreed to a relocation to another planet, but I'd still like to stick it to those Ragtags.|[[Strilath Farles]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP4" />}}
'''Gramo Murah''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Ragtags|Ragtag]] gang who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Oh really. Ha, that's...hmm. Wait a second. Tell you what, if you help me with a little problem, I'll tell you what you want to know.|Strilath Farles, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP4" />}}
Gramo Murah was the leader of a small group of Ragtags based in a [[Ragtag Base|bunker]] in the [[Nomad Mountains]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Murah's goons entered into a violent conflict with another criminal organization, the [[Meatlumps]],<ref name="SWG:TMHP4" /> fanatical anti-technology thugs.<ref name="Meatlumps">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67782&month=052008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Meatlumps!}}</ref> The Ragtags eventually forced [[Strilath Farles]]' band of Meatlumps to relocate from Corellia to the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG:TMHP4" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the ''[[Corellia Times]]'' [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Vani Korr]] tasked a spacer to deal with Strilath Farles in exchange for information about the Meatlumps. The Meatlump lieutenant wanted his revenge on the Ragtags and the adventurer accepted to rid him of Gramo Murah and his gang. The spacer attacked the Ragtag bunker in the mountains and finally killed Gramo Murah and some of the Ragtag goons. The spacer also destroyed their stash of stolen goods. In the end, the death of Gramo Murah was meaningless since Strilath Farles eventually refused to share any information.<ref name="SWG:TMHP4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gramo Murah appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMHP4" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Gramo Murah was added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>

This non-player character (NPC) was known in the game as '''Gramo Murah''' or '''Mramo Gurah''', depending of the Combat Level (CL) of the player. If the player performed the quest "[[W:c:swg:The Meatlumps Hideout|The Meatlumps Hideout, Part 4]]" during the leveling of their character (at CL 65), the NPC would be named Gramo Murah. If the player performed the quest after the end of the game (at CL 90), the NPC would be named Mramo Gurah. Multiple story elements indicated that the quest was intended to be achieved at CL 65.<ref name="SWG:TMHP4" />
